context: Saito leads Ren on a hospital tour for a new article on rural medicine.
purpose: Doctor mentoring young writer on professional setting.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: これが、地方の小さい病院。
lines.en: This is a small rural hospital.
lines.style: Clear, factual opening. Matter-of-fact but not cold. Slight pause after the dash—letting the reality settle. Steady, professional composure masking quiet pride in the work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医者、何人いるんですか?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Soft, respectful tone—asking because he truly wants to understand. No judgment, just engagement.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of the constraint. A small, honest exhale. Not apologetic—factual and clear. The weight of it implied, not stated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Still respectful, still curious. Lighter touch this time—building the picture. Warm engagement without pressing too hard.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.style: Informative, even. A slight softening—acknowledging the reality of relying on their skill and dedication. Still measured, still composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療、大変じゃないですか?
lines.style: Gentle concern, not alarm. A real question born from genuine understanding of the constraints. Soft, thoughtful pace. Inviting her to share the difficulty.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: チームワークで乗り越えます。
lines.style: Quiet conviction beneath the words. A gentle lift on 'teamwork'—not boasting, but grounded in real reliance on each other. Steady, proud in a humble way.
